milestones.name: Save Zote in Greenpath
milestones.note: Knight chooses to rescue Zote from the Vengefly King. If not saved before acquiring Mantis Claw, Zote dies.

milestones.name: Zote arrives in Dirtmouth
milestones.note: Occurs after being saved in Greenpath; Zote appears in Dirtmouth and speaks arrogantly to the Knight.

milestones.name: Zote found in City of Tears
milestones.note: Zote is found in a corridor leading back to the storerooms of the City of Tears, having forgotten the Knight.

milestones.name: Save Zote in Deepnest
milestones.note: Knight chooses to rescue Zote from spider webs in Deepnest. Leaving him does not result in his death.

milestones.name: Zote captured at Colosseum of Fools
milestones.note: If saved both times, Zote is found in the resting area of the Colosseum of Fools.

milestones.name: Defeat Zote (Colosseum of Fools)
milestones.note: Zote is the final boss of the first trial. Deals no damage. Grants the Rivalry achievement.

milestones.name: Neglect achievement
milestones.note: Granted by hitting Zote's shell in Greenpath after he dies (not saved before Mantis Claw acquired).

milestones.name: Rivalry achievement
milestones.note: Granted by beating Zote in the Colosseum of Fools.

milestones.name: Enter City of Tears
milestones.note: The capital city of Hallownest, located at the centre of the kingdom, covered in perpetual rainfall.

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.fingerprintHint: Capital city of Hallownest, perpetual rainfall from ceiling, enormous cavern, storerooms corridor
zones.note: Original name lost to history. Connected to Forgotten Crossroads, Fungal Wastes, Kingdom's Edge, Resting Grounds, and Royal Waterways.

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.fingerprintHint: Path where Zote is held by Vengefly King
zones.note: Zote is found trapped in the mandibles of a Vengefly King along the path leading to Greenpath.

zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.fingerprintHint: Town where Zote appears after being saved in Greenpath
zones.note: Zote shows up here after being rescued in Greenpath.

zones.name: Deepnest
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote found stuck in spider webs, captured by beasts
zones.note: Zote is found stuck in spider webs, presumably captured by the beasts of Deepnest.

zones.name: Colosseum of Fools
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote found in resting area, first trial boss fight
zones.note: Zote is found in the resting area and becomes the final boss of the first trial.

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.note: Listed as a connection to City of Tears.

zones.note: Listed as a connection to City of Tears.

zones.note: Listed as a connection to City of Tears.

zones.note: Listed as a connection to City of Tears.

zones.name: Royal Waterways
zones.note: Listed as a connection to City of Tears.

zones.name: Soul Sanctum
zones.note: Mentioned as a sub-area of the City of Tears.

abilities.name: Mantis Claw
abilities.note: If Zote is not saved before acquiring the Mantis Claw, he dies in his Greenpath location.

bosses.name: Vengefly King
bosses.note: Holds Zote in its mandibles. Knight can choose to fight it to save Zote or leave.

bosses.name: Zote
bosses.note: Final boss of the first trial. Deals no damage due to shellwood nail. Grants Rivalry achievement on defeat.
